questions.question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

 { 96, } 12, (3)/(2), ?, (3)/(128)
questions.solution:
According to the question 

 { 96, } 12, (3)/(2), ?, (3)/(128) 

The pattern followed here is 

When First number is divided by 8 you get the

next number of the series for example

96 ÷ 8 = 12 

Similarly

12 ÷ 8 = 3over 2

3over 2 ÷ 8 = 3over16

Hence, The correct answer is **"Option 4"**
